messages:
Alice M: Quick follow-up from yesterday's DR postmortem — proposing a round-robin ownership model for remediation items so no single team gets overloaded. I sketched owners + tentative timelines in the doc: https://redwood.app/links/dr-remediation-queue (please review).
Ben K: +1. Can we split by surface (routing, backups, runbooks, observability)? I can take multi-region routing for the next 2 weeks.
Carol S: I’ll own backups + restore runbooks. Need a 2-week ETA to validate cross-region snapshots and restore paths; will add a checklist to the runbook.
Sam P: Lia — can Platform help with routing policy changes and a dry-run infra plan? @Lia T
Lia T: Yep. I can take platform changes and run the dry-run. Proposed dry-run: 2026-03-27 14:00 UTC. Need list of test prefixes + expected failover SLOs from Ben.
DevOps Bot: <!here> Scheduled game-day dry-run on 2026-03-27 14:00 UTC (prep call 30m before).
Alice M: Carol — can you paste the runbook snippet you plan to add (so we can review inline)?
Carol S: ```
restore:
  steps:
    - failover-route-check
    - validate-snapshots
    - restore-db
    - post-restore-smoke-tests
  owners:
    backups: Carol S
    routing-contact: Ben K
```
Ben K: For routing I'll add an automated canary + emergency rollback play. ETA: 5 business days to cadence and testing.
Dave R: Noted recurring pattern: KV cache pressure spikes during failovers causing longer tail latencies. Proposing pre-failover cache drain + throttled warmup on the new region. I'll own the implementation and runbook changes.
Lia T: Also suggest adding SLO-driven alert thresholds and tie them to a paging policy. I’ll draft the alert runbook and page thresholds.
Alice M: Great. Capturing owners + due dates here (please confirm): 1) Routing canary — Ben K — 2026-04-03; 2) Backups/restore runbook — Carol S — 2026-04-10; 3) Cache warmup/flush — Dave R — 2026-03-31; 4) Alerting + paging — Lia T — 2026-04-01; 5) Dry-run game-day prep — Sam P — 2026-03-27. I’ll own triage + weekly check-ins. :white_check_mark:
Sam P: I'll create the calendar invite and post the runbook link in #eng-oncall and #incidents.
DevOps Bot: Calendar event created: Game-day dry-run — 2026-03-27 14:00 UTC. invite: https://calendar.example/ev/12345
Carol S: Quick Q — for cross-region snapshot retention, are we good with 7 days default? Ops cost vs RTO tradeoff.
Ben K: Keep 7 days for now; run cost analysis in parallel and we'll revisit. Finance sign-off later.
Alice M: OK — flagged for finance. We'll reconvene next Tuesday for status updates. Thanks everyone.
